# BK REALTOR

> BK REALTOR is a demo Kuala Lumpur real estate analytics and property advisory website led by BK Han, focused on KLCC, Bukit Bintang, and Mont Kiara.

## Summary
- Brand: BK REALTOR
- Owner: BK Han
- Location: KLCC area, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
- Currency: Malaysian Ringgit (RM)
- Sample Contact: hello@bkrealtor.example | +60 3-2100 0000
- Notice: Demo site; listings and figures are sample data.

## Sections
- Overview (#overview): Interactive neighbourhood map filter, RM valuation callout, location details, and community gauge.
- Featured Listings (#listings): Sample Kuala Lumpur condominiums, serviced suites, and penthouses across KLCC, Bukit Bintang, and Mont Kiara.
- Market Pulse (#analytics): Indicative sample median prices, PSF, and gross yields by Kuala Lumpur neighbourhood, plus agency Q&A.
- Contact (#contact): Principal realtor details for BK Han and a demo viewing enquiry form.
